# Camp Resource: Brewing Vat

Get your fill of fermentable beer to start your own collection of alcohol-fueled goodness!

Generates various fermentable alcoholic drinks.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Brewing Vat__

**Produces**

Fermentable Bourbon - 98% chance

Fermentable Blackwater Brew - 98% chance

Fermentable Pickaxe Pilsner - 50% chance

Fermentable Oak Holler Lager - 50% chance

Fermentable Beer - 50% chance

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

TBA

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

15 pounds (15 items)

**Obtainable via**

Season Pass 18 - Milepost Zero: Country Road - 60 tickets

Gold Bullion - Mortimer - Ally - TBC Bullion

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units
